title: Photo
description: Photograph with photographer attribution, dimensions, tags, engagement metrics, and upload timestamp. Used for photo sharing platforms, social media, and photography portfolios.

title.description: Title or caption of the photo

photographer.description: Full name of the photographer who took the photo

url.description: URL to the photo image file

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization and search

likes.description: Number of likes or positive reactions the photo has received

uploaded_at.description: Timestamp when the photo was uploaded
